resolved.title: Just Enough Items (JEI)
resolved.notes: Recipe browser. EMI is an alternative; pick one.

resolved.title: Jade
resolved.notes: HWYLA-style overlay. Helps identify unknown fauna.

resolved.title: GeckoLib
resolved.notes: Required by Jurassic Revived, Cataclysm, many creature mods.

resolved.title: Citadel
resolved.notes: Required by Alex's Mobs, Alex's Caves, Ice and Fire.

resolved.title: Player Animator
resolved.notes: Required by Better Combat / some animation mods. Keep even if using Epic Fight.

resolved.title: Lionfish API
resolved.notes: Required by L_Ender's Cataclysm.

resolved.title: Moonlight Lib
resolved.notes: Required by Supplementaries / Amendments.

resolved.title: Embeddium
resolved.notes: Forge Sodium fork. Required with Oculus for shaders. Do not also install Rubidium/Sodium.

resolved.title: Oculus
resolved.notes: Iris port for Forge. Pairs with Embeddium.

resolved.title: Searchables
resolved.notes: Dependency of Controlling on 1.20.1.

resolved.title: Carry On
resolved.notes: Carry animals/chests — useful for relocating tames.

resolved.title: Entity Texture Features
resolved.notes: Enables Fresh Animations / emissive mob textures on Forge too.

resolved.title: Entity Model Features
resolved.notes: Companion to ETF for Fresh Animations.

resolved.title: Continuity
resolved.notes: Connected textures without OptiFine.

resolved.title: Fossils and Archeology: Revival
resolved.notes: Primary Ark-like loop: fossils, DNA, embryos, taming/riding. Do not also enable Jurassic Revived or Jurassic Reborn.

resolved.title: Alex's Mobs
resolved.notes: Living-world fauna. Citadel required. Last 1.20.1 file Sep 2024 — still the standard.

resolved.title: Alex's Caves
resolved.notes: Alien/xeno cave biomes without GW IP. Citadel required.

resolved.title: Tameable Beasts
resolved.notes: Expands taming/riding. Configure so it does not trivialize Fossils dinos.

resolved.title: Born in Chaos
resolved.notes: Hostile grimdark mobs/structures. Original IP.

resolved.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm
resolved.notes: Boss fauna (Leviathan, Ancient Remnant, etc.) as Carnifex/greater-daemon analogues. Lionfish API + Curios + GeckoLib.

resolved.title: Epic Fight
resolved.notes: Souls-like melee. Forge/NeoForge only. Do not stack Better Combat unless you add a compat mod.

resolved.title: Simply Swords
resolved.notes: Weapon variety for gothic/fantasy warhammer feel. Original designs.

resolved.title: TaCZ (Timeless and Classics Zero)
resolved.notes: Gun framework for bolter-feel. Use original gunpacks — do not install tacz40k (GW IP).

resolved.title: Legendary Survival Overhaul
resolved.notes: Thirst, temperature, body health. Do not also install Tough As Nails, Cold Sweat, or Thirst Was Taken.

resolved.title: Serene Seasons
resolved.notes: Seasons feed LSO temperature. Crop windows = Ark-like climate pressure.

resolved.title: Open Parties and Claims
resolved.notes: Ark tribe analogue: parties + land claims. Prefer this over stacking FTB Teams+Chunks unless you need FTB Quests.

resolved.title: When Dungeons Arise
resolved.notes: Large gothic/imperial ruin structures.

resolved.title: Terralith
resolved.notes: Primary biome overhaul. Do not also enable Biomes O' Plenty or Oh The Biomes We've Gone in v0.1.

resolved.title: Create
resolved.notes: Gothic-industrial factories. Create 6.x bundles Flywheel — do not install legacy Flywheel.

resolved.title: Supplementaries
resolved.notes: Decorative/functional blocks. Needs Moonlight Lib.

resolved.title: Chipped
resolved.notes: Block variants for gothic masonry.

resolved.title: Malum
resolved.notes: Spirit/warp-adjacent magic without GW names. Optional if you want less magic.

resolved.title: Enhanced Celestials
resolved.notes: Blood moons as warp-tide analogue.

resolved.title: ParCool!
resolved.notes: Parkour/mantling — Ark-like traversal. Optional if it fights Epic Fight animations.

resolved.title: Immersive Engineering
resolved.notes: Heavy industrial — great later, noisy with Create 6. Enable in a tech-forward instance.

resolved.title: Immersive Aircraft
resolved.notes: Dropship analogue. Add after core loop is fun.

resolved.title: Hardcore Torches
resolved.notes: Primitive lighting. Can stack with LSO; test burnout pacing.

resolved.title: Spice of Life: Apple Pie Edition
resolved.notes: Diet diversity. SOL Carrot Edition is not current on Modrinth for 1.20.1.

resolved.title: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
resolved.notes: Psyker analogue. Skip in v0.1 if you want survival-first rather than wizard fantasy.

resolved.title: Ice and Fire: Dragons
resolved.notes: 1.20.1 last file is still a 2024 beta. Dragons as wyvern analogues. Compatibility risk with worldgen/mobs.

resolved.title: Prehistoric Fauna
resolved.notes: Accurate time-travel dimensions, limited taming. Conflicts conceptually with Fossils revival loop. Use in a separate 'expedition' instance.

resolved.title: Jurassic Revived
resolved.notes: JurassiCraft successor (park/DNA). Do not mix with Fossils in the same world.

resolved.title: Better Combat
resolved.notes: Conflicts with Epic Fight unless you add a dedicated compat mod. Default pack uses Epic Fight only.

resolved.title: Tough As Nails
resolved.notes: Conflicts with Legendary Survival Overhaul. Listed as TAN-style alternative, not both.

resolved.title: Cold Sweat
resolved.notes: Temperature-only alternative to LSO. Do not stack with LSO.

resolved.title: Ad Astra
resolved.notes: Death-world planets. Saves for a later 'void crusade' phase.

resolved.title: Hammercraft 40k
resolved.notes: LEGAL RISK: uses Games Workshop 40k setting. Forge 1.20.1. Not in default pack. See LEGAL-NOTES.md.

resolved.title: Tacz40k
resolved.notes: LEGAL RISK: 40k gunpack for TaCZ. Do not include in default.

resolved.title: Warhammer: Sons of the Empire
resolved.notes: LEGAL RISK: Warhammer-branded. All Rights Reserved.

resolved.title: Grimdark Sky Pack
resolved.notes: Chaos moon / exoplanet sky. Stack above block packs. Needs custom-sky support (Oculus/OptiFine).

resolved.title: Grimdark Battlepack
resolved.notes: Armor/weapon CIT variants. Anvil-rename variants need CIT (OptiFine) or may be limited on Oculus.

resolved.title: Faithful 32x
resolved.notes: Base 32x pack under grimdark addons.

resolved.title: Fresh Animations
resolved.notes: Needs ETF + EMF.

resolved.title: Thalyrus II Medieval Age
resolved.notes: Alternative medieval overhaul pack. Do not stack with Faithful as both bases.

resolved.title: Dramatic Skys
resolved.notes: Conflicts with Grimdark Sky — pick one sky pack.

resolved.title: Complementary Shaders - Unbound
resolved.notes: Darker/more cinematic Complementary profile. Use with Oculus+Embeddium.

resolved.title: Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
resolved.notes: Brighter Complementary profile. Alternative to Unbound.

manual_curseforge_only.title: Epic Knights: Shields, Armor and Weapons (Magistu)
manual_curseforge_only.notes: Not on Modrinth. Add via CurseForge/Prism from CF. Gothic plate that reads as chapter/knight armour. 1.20.1 Forge file updated Mar 2026.

conflicts.reason: Overlapping DNA/dino systems and spawn tables. Default: Fossils only.
Both rewrite combat. Compat mods exist but are extra moving parts. Default: Epic Fight.
Stacked biome mods wreck spawn rates and performance. Default: Terralith.
Reported scope/zoom breakage when both are loaded.
